citation.journal: Journal of the American Academy of Dermatology

cited_by.title: Hair breakage, growth and keeping length

record.finding: Afro-textured shafts knotted and fractured far more often when combed: 10 to 16% of shafts knotted against 0.15% in other groups.
record.note: 12 volunteers with no chemical treatment and limited grooming: shows untreated hair, not how common knotting is in daily life.
